end.summary: Explored “unity in diversity” and how differences can enrich society.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining unity in diversity through language, food, dress, festivals, music, and shared values. They used examples such as Pongal, Bihu, Lohri, phiran, set-mundu, and shared foods, and connected different forms to common ideas like belonging and celebration. A concern about differences causing conflict was discussed through sharing and celebrating respectfully; no lasting mix-up was noted. At home, ask Riya to give one example of a shared idea with two different cultural forms.
